name: Exposed
source:
A young man is in a battle of the minds and bodies with a fierce MILF, both seeking to outplay the other. Delve into a story of near misses and close calls as you try to live out your wildest dreams without getting EXPOSED!

A parody of the Y3DF comic "Busted".
translation:
一名年轻小伙与一位火辣泼辣的熟女展开了一场身心交锋的较量，双方都企图在这场博弈中压倒对方。置身于一次次险象环生、擦肩而过的惊险场面之中，在不被当场抓包暴露的前提下尽情实现你最狂野的幻想吧！

本作改编自Y3DF创作的漫画《抓包》（Busted）。
